label: Full FA Auction lifecycle on mobile. The FA Auction now has a Players tab with EVERY free agent in the league (searchable — tap Nominate once the commish opens the auction), a Lots tab that toggles between Open and Completed lots (who won, final price, bid count), and a Bid History feed. Expired Rookie gets the same Lots + History (split correctly by auction). All five-plus sub-tabs per auction.
